matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the unified actor loss definition in Section 4.2 and Appendix I.2, specifically the inclusion of β_div·L_div and β_dyn·L_dyn terms and inconsistent treatment of L_BC. Finding 1 points to Equation (5) in Appendix I.1 regarding a dimensional issue with a BC penalty term in a value function expression. These are different equations in different locations addressing different issues.

GT2 concerns inconsistent critic update formulas across SAC-N, CQL, and EDAC pseudocode (specifically the use of mean vs min aggregation of q_values in the actor update). Finding 1 addresses a dimensional inconsistency in Equation (5) in Appendix I.1, which is a different location and different issue than the pseudocode inconsistencies described in GT2.

pred_verdicts.rationale: The finding identifies a legitimate dimensional inconsistency in Equation (5) that is not covered by the ground truth defects.
